question: Which among the following films received the Filmfare award for the Best Film popular choice in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Filmfare Awards are one of the most prestigious film awards in India.
 
• They are presented annually by the Filmfare magazine to honor excellence in the Hindi film industry, also known as Bollywood.
 
• The awards were first introduced in 1954 and have since become one of the most highly anticipated events in the Indian film calendar.
 
• The Filmfare Awards recognize outstanding performances and achievements in various categories, including Best Film, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress, Best Supporting Actor, Best Supporting Actress, Best Music, and more.
 
• The winners are chosen through a voting process that involves members of the film industry, including actors, directors, producers, and critics. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **List of FILMFARE AWARDS 2022 WINNERS**

 
 
• Best Film: **Shershaah (Dharma Productions)**
 
• Best Director:** Vishnuvardhan (Shershaah)**
 
• Best Actor:** Ranveer Singh (83) as Kapil Dev**
 
• Best Actress: **Kriti Sanon, Mimi as Mimi Rathore**
 
• Best Supporting Actor: **Pankaj Tripathi (Mimi)**
 
• Best Supporting Actress: **Sai Tamhankar (Mimi)**
 
• Best Male Debut:** Ehan Bhat – 99 Songs as Jay**
 
• Best Female Debut: S**harvari Wagh – Bunty Aur Babli 2 as Sonia Rawat / Jasmine “Jazz”**
 
• Best Debut Director: **Seema Pahwa – Ramprasad Ki Tehrvi**
 
• Best Story: **Abhishek Kapoor, Supratik Sen and Tushar Paranjape (Chandigarh Kare Aashiqui)**
 
• Best Screenplay: **Shubendu Bhattacharya and Ritesh Shah (Sardar Udham)**
 
• Best Dialogue: **Dibakar Banerjee and Varun Grover (Sandeep Aur Pinky Faraar)**
 
• Best Music Director: **Tanishk Bagchi, B Praak, Jaani, Jasleen Royal, Javed-Mohsin And Vikram Montrose (Shershaah)**
 
• Best Lyricist: Kausar Munir –** “Lehra Do” (83)**
 
• Best Playback Singer (Male): **B Praak – “Mann Bharrya” (Shershaah)**
 
• Best Playback Singer (Female): **Asees Kaur – “Raataan Lambiya” (Shershaah).**
 
• Best Film (Best Director): **Shoojit Sircar (Sardar Udham)**
 
• Best Actor: Vicky Kaushal – **Sardar Udham as Udham Singh**
 
• Best Actress: Vidya Balan – **Sherni as Vidya Vincent.**
 
• Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award: **Subhash Ghai.**
